item_name: Rothco Vintage Veteran Low Pro Cap
item_short_desc: Embrace your veteran status with Rothco’s Vintage Veteran Low Pro Cap. This classic cap is designed with pride in mind, featuring an embroidered “Veteran” and US flag on the front panel. The adjustable hook and loop closure back, along with the inner sweatband, ensure a comfortable and secure fit for all-day wear. Made of 100% brushed cotton twill, this cap offers a soft and durable feel, perfect for everyday use.
